meta.name: performing-supply-chain-attack-simulation
meta.description: Simulate and detect software supply chain attacks including typosquatting detection via Levenshtein distance, dependency confusion testing against private registries, package hash verification with pip, and known vulnerability scanning with pip-audit.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能够模拟和检测软件供应链攻击，包括检查依赖混淆（内部包名是否在公共仓库存在更高版本）、typosquatting（拼写相似的恶意包名）、验证包的 SHA-256 哈希，以及用 pip-audit 扫描已知漏洞。
howto.when: 当用户要求进行软件供应链安全检测或攻击模拟时触发，例如询问“检查依赖风险”或“模拟供应链攻击”。

howto.what_en: Claude can simulate and detect software supply chain attacks: check for dependency confusion (internal package names existing on public PyPI at higher versions), typosquatting (similar package names via Levenshtein distance), verify package SHA-256 hashes, and scan known CVEs with pip-audit.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests a software supply chain security audit or attack simulation, e.g., asking 'check dependency risks' or 'simulate supply chain attack'.

say_en.text: Check my project dependencies for typosquatting malicious packages.
Detect dependency confusion vulnerabilities in my current Python project.
Verify all package hashes and scan for known CVEs.
say_en.note: Triggers hash verification and vulnerability scanning
